Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I see a batch of Tier-B requests in eu-west that fell back to a lower-capacity model variant. Need better playback/headers in Console so support/product can triage impact.

Arjun Patel: Can you paste one of the routing traces/headers you saw?

Maya Chen: Here's a sanitized example from the carrier logs:```
X-Request-ID: r-9a1f2c
X-Redwood-Routing: tier=B;region=eu-west;route_id=rb-123;decision=variant_fallback
X-Redwood-Routing-Trace: hop1=tier:lookup|hop2=region:eu-west|hop3=capacity:overloaded|hop4=fallback:model-v1-8q|reason=queue_depth
```

Sam Rodriguez: Is this production traffic or canary? Any increase in 5xx or latency?

Maya Chen: Production, within the last hour. 5xx didn't jump but P95 rose from 120ms -> 360ms for affected keys, which triggered capacity-based fallback. ~0.5% of requests in that window. Log snippet:```
[2026-03-18T14:02:12Z] r-9a1f2c route=rb-123 primary_queue=82% fallback=true model=model-v1-8q latency=340ms
```

Priya Nair: Product ask: Console UX should show per-customer "routing playback" — a mini-timeline of decision hops (tier->region->capacity->variant) and the explicit reason (eg queue_depth). Also surface estimated cost delta when fallback used.

Arjun Patel: From infra side: routing decision composed by policy engine: customer_tier -> region -> capacity check -> model_variant selection -> fallback. Proposal: add structured header for each decision hop, sampled and aggregated. Example header we could emit:```
X-Redwood-Routing-Decision: tier=B|region=eu-west|check=capacity|outcome=overloaded|fallback=model-v1-8q|reason=queue_depth|route_id=rb-123
```
We should also include a short trace id for full playback lookups. Sampling important to limit volume.

Lena Thompson: +1. Also capture batch_size and kv_cache_hits at decision time so playback can reproduce perf delta. Might be: `batch=16|kv_hits=0` in the header or in the APm event.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-policy v1.14 pushed to canary in eu-west by @ArjunPatel :rocket:

Arjun Patel: Another implementation note: add an opt-in per-customer "detailed-route-playback" flag (enterprise feature) to force 100% sampling for that tenant for a limited window. Otherwise default sampling 1% or adaptive sampling triggered on error/latency thresholds. This helps with quotas — full traces are expensive.

Maya Chen: UX follow-up: Console filters to add: decision reason, model_variant, route_id, and a metric card "Fallback impact" showing delta in latency/cost when fallback applied vs baseline. Also link each trace to the raw header and a replay snapshot.

Sam Rodriguez: Implementation constraints: store a minimal decision envelope in APM/event (small JSON blob) and write full playback traces to object storage with an ID. APM gets the ID + a handful of fields to keep observability queries cheap.

Arjun Patel: Sounds good. I can draft header schema and a minimal trace envelope with fields: trace_id, route_id, decision_hops (as short string), model_variant, batch, kv_hits, reason, sampling_flag.

Maya Chen: I'll open an RFC for the Console changes + telemetry mapping. @Arjun Patel @Sam Rodriguez can you add the storage + header field requirements to the RFC? We also need analytics to estimate billing delta for fallback cases.

Arjun Patel: Will do, will include a proposed header blacklist to avoid PII.

Sam Rodriguez: I'll scope SLO impact dashboard + alert rules.

Maya Chen: Great — thanks all. Short term action items: Arjun sketch schema, Sam scope dashboards, Priya own UX mockups, I'll draft RFC and assign.

Priya Nair: +1 on ownership. We should add a tiny "why this routed" tooltip in route details to reduce support tickets.

Lena Thompson: One more technical: ensure the routing header format can be extended (k/v pairs) and make it safe for proxies (max length budget).

Arjun Patel: Agreed — we'll put the full playback in object store and keep headers <1kB.

Maya Chen: Cool. I'll tag owners in the RFC and follow up in next sync. :thumbsup:
